messages:
ana: opened PR to update docs/cli/evidence-export.md with clearer SOC2-friendly language and two runnable examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/905
peter: thanks. which flags are safe for normal customer exports? wondering what to recommend in the quickstart.
sasha: default should be safe/PII-removed. prefer flag name --user-identifiers rather than --identifiers. also call out legal gating for full exports.
peter: agree on flag rename. can we add a one-line note that full exports require a signed legal request + audit log entry?
ana: added note: "Full exports (with --user-identifiers) require an authorized legal request and are logged in the Compliance Audit Trail."
ana: included two examples:
```bash
# anonymized export (default)
redwood export-evidence --since 2024-01-01 --until 2024-01-31 --format jsonl --anonymize

# full export for legal/forensics (legal approval required)
redwood export-evidence --since 2024-01-01 --format jsonl --user-identifiers --auth-token $TOKEN
```
sasha: tiny phrasing ask: "are redacted by default" instead of "will be redacted" to avoid future-tense ambiguity. also add a warning that anonymized exports remove stable IDs and may prevent cross-event correlation.
ana: updated wording and pushed commit.
legal-bot: reminder: Any docs that describe access to user-identifiers must be reviewed by Security & Legal. Please request review with tag @legal-team.
peter: tagging @legal-team in the PR now. also pinging @security for audit-trail phrasing.
sasha: added an inline snippet showing how to request the export via support portal link and legal playbook: https://redwood-internal/legal/export-process (internal)
link-bot: link-check: external links OK, internal link flagged as internal-only :warning: (OK for docs but add internal note).
ana: noted. will mark the internal link as "internal: do not publish" in the public build.
peter: can we add a one-sentence note about retention TTL alignment with SOC2 (30/90/365 days depending on plan)? keep it high level and link to retention policy.
sasha: added: "Retention TTLs vary by subscription tier; see retention policy for details. Exports respect configured TTL and do not return events older than the tenant's retention setting unless legal hold is in place"
ana: awesome. I'll wait for legal and security sign-off before merging and then create a short changelog entry.
peter: LGTM pending sig-off.
sasha: quick local test of the CLI samples passed.
legal-bot: queued for review. ETA 48h.
link-bot: all public links validated :white_check_mark:
ana: thanks all, will follow up with merge after approvals.
